edges.reason: mint amount parameter drives payment and supply checks in mint.
msg.sender is the mint recipient in mint.
mintPrice is read to compute the required msg.value in mint.
saleActive gates execution of mint.
MAX_AMOUNT_PER_MINT bounds the amount accepted by mint.
MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY bounds total supply in mint.
mint performs amount * mintPrice multiplication susceptible to arithmetic issues.
mint computes amount + totalSupply() for supply validation.
reserve recipient address flows into _mint.
reserve amount flows into supply and reserved cap checks.
reserved counter is read and incremented in reserve.
MAX_RESERVED_AMOUNT caps reserved mints.
MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY caps total supply in reserve.
reserve computes amount + totalSupply() for supply validation.
msg.sender is the withdrawal recipient in withdraw.
withdraw performs an external value call to msg.sender.
recipient can re-enter withdraw via fallback before completion.
tokenId parameter selects the token acted upon in plunge.
tokenLevels is read and written by plunge.
isLocked gates plunge execution and is set on failure.
MAX_LEVEL bounds valid upgrades in plunge.
plunge calls _genPseudoRandomNumber whose result determines the outcome.
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random hash, enabling timestamp dependency.
random value returned by _genPseudoRandomNumber controls plunge branching.
plunge outcome relies on weak pseudo-randomness that a miner/owner can influence.
plunge writes the upgraded or reset level into tokenLevels.
plunge sets isLocked to true on a failed upgrade.
currentLevel local is loaded from tokenLevels in plunge.
pseudoRandomHash local is computed inside _genPseudoRandomNumber.
revealed flag determines tokenURI branch.
_unrevealedURI is returned while unrevealed.
_lockedURIHeaven is returned for locked even tokens.
_lockedURIHell is returned for locked odd tokens.
isLocked select the locked URI branch in tokenURI.
tokenLevels is appended to the returned URI in tokenURI.
_baseTokenURI prefixes the revealed token URI.
tokenId parameter is used in the URI composition and parity check.
wallet parameter drives the enumeration in walletOfOwner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the owner.
onlyOwner reads the stored _owner for authorization.
withdraw is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
reserve is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipSaleStatus is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipReveal is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipLockStatus is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMintPrice is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setUnrevealedURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setLockedURIHeaven is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setLockedURIHell is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyTokenOwner compares msg.sender with ownerOf(tokenId).
plunge is restricted by the onlyTokenOwner modifier.
flipSaleStatus toggles the saleActive state variable.
flipReveal toggles the revealed state variable.
flipLockStatus toggles the isLocked entry for a tokenId.
tokenId parameter selects the isLocked entry toggled.
setMintPrice writes the mintPrice state variable.
price parameter is assigned to mintPrice.
setBaseURI writes the _baseTokenURI state variable.
baseURI parameter is assigned to _baseTokenURI.
setUnrevealedURI writes the _unrevealedURI state variable.
setLockedURIHeaven writes the _lockedURIHeaven state variable.
setLockedURIHell writes the _lockedURIHell state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: mint amount parameter is only meaningful within the mint entry point.
reserve recipient parameter is bound to the reserve function.
reserve amount parameter is bound to the reserve function.
plunge tokenId parameter is local to the plunge function.
tokenURI tokenId parameter is local to the tokenURI view.
walletOfOwner wallet parameter is local to that view.
setMintPrice price parameter is bound to its setter.
flipLockStatus tokenId parameter is bound to that owner function.
setBaseURI parameter is bound to the setBaseURI setter.
pseudoRandomHash local is produced and consumed only in _genPseudoRandomNumber.
currentLevel local is a temporary read of tokenLevels inside plunge.
pseudoRandomNumber local is the randomness result used for plunge branching.
